name: Tuta Desktop
description: The retained Tuta desktop build tooling documents RSA/SHA-512 verification of installer signatures against the tutao public key and attaches the signature to update metadata. This is build and release-signing evidence; it does not independently establish the electron-updater runtime path or every platform’s fail-closed behavior.
limitations: The candidate source is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
Runtime electron-updater enforcement and released artifact behavior remain outside this build-tool evidence.
